source: Supplementary Material of "Static Effective Hamiltonians for Molecular Systems Through RPA-based Downfolding": data/BondDissociation/JobResults.csv (rows omega == 0, ActiveSpaceSolver == FCI), data/EffectiveTwoBodyTerms/*.txt, data/ScreeningFrequencyDependence/NeutralExcitations.txt. AMS BAND, spherical Gaussian basis sets, eta = 1e-3.
units: r in Angstrom, the molecule along z; energies and traces in Hartree.
active_space: n_act_occ, n_act_virt are nActOcc, nActVirt: (0, 0) every orbital in the environment, (-1, -1) every orbital active.

benzene_66_frobenius.quantity: sqrt(sum C^2), C = (v_eff - v)_{pq,rs} at omega = 0 (signed in the files although the README says abs).
benzene_66_frobenius.compound_index: x = pq, y = rs over the 21 pairs p <= q of the 6 active orbitals, row-major (x = 0: 00, 1: 01, ..., 5: 05, 6: 11, ...); every (x, y) appears once, both (x, y) and (y, x).
benzene_66_frobenius.multiplicity: 'table' counts every (x, y) once; 'four_index' weights each by m_x m_y, m = 1 for p == q and 2 for p < q: the Frobenius norm of the full (n,)*4 tensor.

benzene_1010_omega_r.quantity: the neutral excitation energies Omega^R of the environment response, Hartree, in the order listed.
